name: init-check-reconcile-conflict-safety
title: INIT_CHECK reconcile must not commit unresolved merge-conflict markers into story metadata
description: During story_advance INIT_CHECK, commitInitCheckMetadataAndMergeMain (cli-engine.ts) commits the INIT_CHECK metadata on main and then merges main into the story branch. Under heavy concurrent main churn (observed 2026-06-16 while driving B-3990), that merge conflicted on the story's index.json (phase INIT on the story branch vs INIT_CHECK on main) and left UNRESOLVED git conflict markers (<<<<<<<, =======, >>>>>>>) committed into index.json. The CLI then could not parse the story at all (every command failed with a JSON parse error at the marker line) until a manual repair (taking main's clean version). Story metadata is machine-generated, so a conflict should never strand the user: the reconcile must either resolve metadata conflicts deterministically (the post-advance / main state wins) or detect a conflicted merge and abort cleanly with a clear recovery path, never commit markers. Likely interacts with the main-write-lock (B-f60c) serialization and B-804c INIT_CHECK atomicity work (which touched cli-engine.ts but not this conflict path). Scope: the INIT_CHECK reconcile merge conflict handling; do not rework unrelated transitions.
